response.sql: WITH combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, avg_optvolrt - AVG(avg_optvolrt) OVER () AS deviation FROM combinations), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM compared WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind
